text: I have some hard news to share. The doctor called today with the test results, and it's not what we hoped for. I know this is scary to hear, but we are going to face this together as a family. We will talk more when you get home.

I am writing to share that due to the recent restructuring, your role has unfortunately been impacted. This was an incredibly difficult decision and is in no way a reflection of your outstanding work over the past two years. HR will be in touch with the severance details.

I didn't want to tell you this over text, but I haven't been able to reach you. I wanted to let you know that my dog, Buster, passed away this morning. I know how much you loved him too. I'm taking a few days offline to process.

This is the hardest thing I've ever had to write. I have realized that we are heading in different directions, and I don't think we should stay together. I care for you deeply, but I know this isn't right for either of us anymore. I'm so sorry for the pain this causes.
I am writing to inform you that our community center will be closing permanently at the end of the month due to funding shortages. Thank you for your support over the years.
Hey, I have some tough news. I just found out I lost my job today. I'm feeling pretty shell-shocked right now and might not be very responsive, but I wanted you to know.

I wanted to let you know that I won't be able to make it to the family reunion this year. I've been struggling with my mental health lately and need to prioritize my recovery right now. I hope you all understand and have a wonderful time together.

I need to share something difficult. My financial situation has taken a major hit, and I won't be able to be a bridesmaid in your wedding. I am so devastated to miss out, but I simply cannot afford the expenses. I love you and support you so much.
